meta.title: Basmet Dawah: a guided path for new Muslims
meta.description: Answer six short questions to find your starting point, then learn Islam one short lesson at a time, in the right order. Free, in English, Arabic, and Spanish.

hero.lead: Six gentle questions, then we choose your first lesson.

welcome.lead: Pick up right where you left off.

ready.lead: Start whenever you feel ready. Each lesson takes a few minutes.
ready.fallback: Paths for your stage are on the way. Start here for now.

two.body: Chosen for where you are now.

three.title: Learn a little at a time
three.body: Each lesson takes a few minutes.

mentor.title: You are not alone
mentor.body: A volunteer mentor can walk beside you. Ask anything, big or small.
